content.about: Antigua and Barbuda is a Caribbean nation of two main islands and many smaller ones. It is famous for white beaches and clear water. Nelson's Dockyard is a restored 18th-century naval base. Barbuda has a big frigatebird colony.

standout.text: Antigua is said to have 365 beaches, one for every day of the year.

didYouKnow: Barbuda's frigatebird colony is one of the largest.
Sailing Week is a famous regatta.
